deploy-bot: Preflight for wave 'midnight-eu' scheduled 00:30 UTC. Changes: runtime v2.4.1 (kv-evict tweak), api v2.9 (header-split), console schema v2026-03, router header-rule. Pins set: runtime=2.4.1, api=2.9. Canary plan proposed 5% -> 25% over 30m. Please ack and post rollback criteria + traffic cutoff windows.

sam: ack. small note: kv-evict warmup can bump p95. propose two-step canary: 5% for 15m, then 20% for 30m. rollback if p95 > 2.0s or error_rate_in_5m > 0.5%.

priya: console migration requires a short read-only window (~2m). we need to do migration before traffic ramps. if auth team can't sign off, we delay.

josh: router header change needs fallback for v2.8 clients. add `router.allow-legacy=true` during first 60m.

ana: Will monitor KV eviction logs during canary: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod | grep kv_evict`

sam: :thumbsup: I'll prepare runbook snippets and shepherd the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary plan applied: 5% for 15m -> 20% for 30m -> 60% for 15m -> 100%. Pins saved: runtime@2.4.1, api@2.9. Rollback shortcut: `/deploy rollback wave-midnight-eu --to runtime@2.4.0,api@2.8`.

liam: reminder: EU maintenance window is 23:45-01:00 UTC. need auth signoff for console write lock. @priya can you confirm?

priya: confirmed. i'll take migration at 00:28 UTC and set console read-only 00:27-00:30. if migration fails we abort and rollback.

josh: add metric guard: `router.5xx_rate > 0.3%` triggers immediate rollback. also watch `canary_error_budget` and `p95_delta`.

ana: if KV eviction causes OOMs, rollback immediately. OOM threshold: `oom_count_5m > 3`.

sam: running shepherd duties. runbook snippet: 
```
# quick runtime checks
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n prod logs $(kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=runtime -o name | head -n1) | tail -n200
# watch metrics: p95, error_rate, oom_count
```

deploy-bot: deploy-start: canary step 1 executed at 00:30:00 UTC. status: in-progress.

sam: 00:31 - canary 5% healthy. p50 stable, p95 +0.12s. no errors. recommended proceed to step 2 at 00:46.

josh: router toggled `allow-legacy=true` for 60m.

sam: 00:59 - at 20% now. p95 drift under threshold. console migration completed at 00:58 OK. marking migration=ok.

priya: confirmed console logs show zero migration errors, syncs all good.

ana: monitoring: no OOMs, cpu spikes within expected. continuing watch.

deploy-bot: final ramp executed: 100% at 01:05 UTC. wave 'midnight-eu' complete. all pins applied.

sam: leaving release notes snippet: kv-evict behavior tweaked to reduce cache churn, router header routing opt-in added, console schema migration performed in short read-only window.

josh: recommend follow-up: validate long-tail latency over next 24h and check canary metrics dashboards.

liam: thanks everyone. closing thread.
